That "dead" look usually points to a simple power issue first, like a loose plug or a switched-off socket, rather than a broken machine part. It could also be a fault with the mains lead or internal wiring if it's been moved recently. Please check that the wall socket is working by plugging in another device, and make sure your washing machine's plug is firmly seated at both ends. It sounds like you are dealing with a "truly dead" machine since there is no power at all. The most likely cause is a fault in the mains lead or the internal power supply unit. Since you can't access these parts, I would recommend getting a qualified engineer to take a look for safety reasons.
